differential_verification.observation: All version-matrix fixtures parse with one type and one object; dedicated fixtures additionally exercise multiple-object layouts.
differential_verification.scope_limit: The synthetic v16 fixture validates the index-only example accepted by UnityPy; it does not settle the conflicting general v16 raw32 interpretation.

evidence_limits: The v2/v3 legacy node deltas follow UnityPy 1.25.2 and AssetStudio. Current AssetRipper applies one legacy layout and is not an oracle for those deltas.

The v16 raw32 value is intentionally index-only in this synthetic case. UnityPy, AssetStudio, and AssetsTools.NET disagree with AssetRipper and uTinyRipper; only a Unity-authored 5.5 fixture can settle the general encoding.
